nodes.label: Green supply chain

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Industry, innovation and infrastructure|Green manufacturing|Green supply chain_qna_000
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How does the use of green technology in the three-layer supply chain model help in saving electricity costs by at least 30%?
nodes.answer: The model's use of green technology for power supply helps in saving electricity costs by 30%.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Industry, innovation and infrastructure|Green manufacturing|Green supply chain_qna_001
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: How can three-echelon supply chain models consider carbon emission and item deterioration?
nodes.answer: Three-echelon supply chain models can consider carbon emission and item deterioration by incorporating these factors into their optimization processes, ensuring that environmental impacts and product quality are taken into account in decision-making processes.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Industry, innovation and infrastructure|Green manufacturing|Green supply chain_qna_002
nodes.label: Science and Tech
nodes.question: How significant are environmental costs in a fashion Green Supply Chain?
nodes.answer: A model developed by Botany et al. in 2020 highlights the importance of including environmental costs in quantifying economic and environmental sustainability dimensions of a Fashion Green Supply Chain.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Industry, innovation and infrastructure|Green manufacturing|Green supply chain_qna_003
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: How do inventory management methods contribute to environmental sustainability?
nodes.answer: Inventory management methods help businesses minimize purchasing, holding, and stock out costs, thus promoting environmental sustainability by reducing waste and resource consumption.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Industry, innovation and infrastructure|Green manufacturing|Green supply chain_qna_004
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: How have businesses integrated sustainable practices in their inventory management?
nodes.answer: Businesses have integrated sustainable practices in their inventory management by considering sustainability in their inventory management costs and business models, making it more appealing in the current environmentally-conscious world.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Industry, innovation and infrastructure|Green manufacturing|Green supply chain_qna_005
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: How can companies address challenges related to material utilization and waste-saving costs in the supply chain stages?
nodes.answer: Companies can address challenges by implementing strategies such as WFM, 5 S, LCA, and KPIs, which require a significant initial investment but result in long-term cost savings and enhanced sustainability performance.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Industry, innovation and infrastructure|Green manufacturing|Green supply chain_qna_006
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: Why is integrating all environmental protection technology concepts in the supply chain of the textile industry crucial for minimizing total cost and environmental damages?
nodes.answer: Integrating all environmental protection technology concepts in the supply chain of the textile industry is crucial for minimizing total cost and environmental damages because focusing on only one concept will not be as effective, and a coordinated approach is needed to address various aspects of sustainability.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Industry, innovation and infrastructure|Green manufacturing|Green supply chain_qna_007
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: In what ways does the proposed three-layer supply chain model change the perspective of people towards lifestyle into being more eco-friendly and sustainable?
nodes.answer: The proposed three-layer supply chain model changes people's perspective towards a more eco-friendly and sustainable lifestyle in the fashion industry.
